label: Rattled and uneasy
summary: A global tech rout set the tone. The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on Thursday, its worst day since April 2025, and the Nasdaq dropped 5.5% into correction on fears Democrats will curb AI data centres. Japan's Nikkei entered a bear market and Seoul's Kospi tripped circuit breakers. Brent neared $100 as ship attacks continued and Trump warned the US may have to 'destroy' the rest of Iran, though Tehran sent a nuclear proposal via Qatar. Trump said a Russia-Ukraine deal was close, but the two traded strikes and the Komyshuvakha toll reached 43. Paraguay's Congress refused President Peña's resignation after a bank collapse stranded about 3 million customers. France saw mass cost-of-living protests, and Macao jailed a former lawmaker. Fiji edged toward a drought emergency. California's governor moved to commute all 548 death sentences, and astronauts finished the ISS solar upgrade. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
